decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch fits the firm's traditional Christmas woodcraft core and was featured on the home page, so prior investment and visible commitment favour keeping it despite the gap in website evidence.
Christmas pyramids are central to the firm's established direction and were prominently showcased, so management would treat any weak sales as seasonal or temporary.

The electronic music box is a visible innovation backed by tooling investment and follow-up disc editions, so management would persist and attribute weak results to pandemic-related market conditions.
The firm publicly reinforced this platform with a second edition and its own page, an escalating commitment that makes dropping it hard to justify.
The Christmas motif platform extends the music box line the firm has committed to and is seasonal, so disappointing results can be read as temporary.
The Dresden-themed pyramid is a home-page product in the firm's core category, so sunk design costs and visibility favour keeping it.
